name: Fetish Locator: S&M Studio
detailed_description:
Fetish Locator: S&M Studio — a brand-new standalone visual novel and official sequel to the Fetish Locator Trilogy featuring fan-favorite Stacy. Your journey will continue together in this entirely new story filled with lust and unexpected turns.

During the hectic final days of the Fetish Locator conspiracy, you and Stacy started making plans for the future. With a bond forged by mutual desire and a thirst for something new, you chose to leave college behind and dive into a future filled with new opportunities, discoveries, and encounters. But the past doesn’t let go so easily.

Fetish Locator: S&M Studio starts with Season 1 and will continue your adventure a few months after Fetish Locator Week 3 ends. In Season 1 you’ll experience a rich and dynamic story featuring bold, multifaceted characters exploring themes of sexual liberation, self-discovery, and unapologetic desire.

We have packed this new chapter with engaging storylines, steamy erotic scenes, a range of new relationships, and intense emotional connections.

The passion that created this new storyline is all about you and Stacy taking your experiences from Fetish Locator and opening up your own adult film studio.

But to do this, you're going to need a lot of resources, so your first step is to dive into the job market. Luckily, this means that in addition to making some cash, you'll get to meet many stunning women while you navigate two different job locations, each with its own challenges and solutions. The bonus? Many of the characters you meet at work may be the perfect candidates to star in your unique cinematic experiences.

3 ways to play the game

In S&M, we're offering players 3 ways to play, so that you can find the playstyle that is right for you.

  • "Full Experience" includes the full sandbox with a city map, mini-games, jobs, dates, studio upgrades, and character discovery. 

  • "No Minigames" gives you the full experience without mini-games — perfect for players who prefer story and exploration without gameplay challenges. 

  • "No Sandbox" turns the game into a classic visual novel like the original Fetish Locator Trilogy.  You don't need to earn money or level up your scenes, just play through the story and enjoy the scenes.

🔥 Who Will You Meet?

💼 The IT Office Beauties
Among the heroines you’ll find in the office are Claire, a cold, commanding businesswoman who covers up a troubled past with her unyielding drive. Moving right along, you'll be working Anna, a woman who would rather be gaming than coding. She is good at her job but is also looking to escape the cubicle confines of the office. And what's an office work environment without a rival? April is a sharp-tongued code monkey who never has a kind word for her new desk partner, but that doesn't matter because she's the best, isn't she? Last but not least, you will make friends with Nari, the other newcomer. As it turns out, you can discover that she has a very impressive sensual side and she is interested in acting out fantasies that will surprise even the most experienced players.

🎭 Theater Girls
All life is a stage, and it's time for you to make your entrance. Dive into a cast of charismatic, passionate actresses. Taisia is a no-nonsense performer who is ready to move past the stage to carve out a spot for herself in the adult industry. Kelly is a diva with ice in her veins who still has a very special route to melt through her defenses. Then there is Veronica, the airhead, the idiot savant, who also happens to be very interested in your past because of a certain app. Every girl in the theater has her secrets — and every one of them can open up to you in unexpected ways.

❤️ Fan-Favorite Heroines Return
For anyone who was a fan of the original trilogy, we have several beloved characters returning to play a role in the new game. The stories of Am-Rose, Lyssa, and Min will continue in Fetish Locator: S&M, and their relationships with you can evolve and become even greater and hotter than anything you've experienced. It's time to turn over a new leaf and these returning FL fans will be right there with you.

✨ All-New Temptations
Just like with the Fetish Locator Trilogy, you'll get to enjoy a wide range of fetishes and scenes in this new adventure. Each erotic scene has been sculpted to make your pulse quicken and your eyes widen. Beyond our juicy writing and steamy renders, every erotic scene comes with a set of animations to make each scene as memorable as the last.  

🎮 Gameplay Features

  • Three different modes to suit your playstyle

  • Steamy close-up sex scenes with loads of scintillating animation.

  • A whole city to explore. S&M gives you a world view map to navigate all the different places of the city. 

  • Point and click navigation of many interior locations, such as the IT Office and the local Theater, and of course, your up-and-coming Adult Film Studio.

  • A branching choice system that directly impacts the story.

  • Individual character and group pages so you can check out all your knowledge of the characters you have met on your adventure.

  • A quest log with detailed instructions to keep all your quests organized and to help make sure you never get lost in the sandbox.

  • Streamlined navigation with multiple location types: office, theater, photo studio, city park, and more.

  • Mini-games for each job and interactive quests with both main and side characters.

Fetish Locator: S&M Studio invites you into a world where desire is raw, limits are pushed, and every choice shapes your destiny.

There is so much to explore, so make sure to add this new adventure to your wishlist so you're all ready to lose yourself to passion and exploration when the game arrives.
